name: Task decomposition
purpose: Break an approved implementation plan into reviewable tasks with owners and verification evidence.
trigger: An implementation plan spans multiple independent changes or contributors.
prerequisites: Scope, architecture, and acceptance criteria are approved.

steps.action: Create tasks with one observable outcome and a bounded change set each.
Record dependencies and order tasks so each increment stays buildable.
Assign a focused test and required gates to every task.

recovery: If a task has no testable outcome, split or rewrite it before assignment.
If dependencies form a cycle, return to planning and resolve the boundary.
